conventions.convention: The Seifert matrix uses V_ij = lk(a_i⁺,a_j), with the positive normal determined by the ambient and surface orientations. Knot Seifert data assume full AC.
A metabolizer is a rank-g primitive direct summand of a rank-2g integral Seifert lattice, with the bilinear pairing identically zero on it; rank zero is allowed.
Δ_K(t) agrees with det(V−tVᵀ) up to a Laurent unit ±tᵏ. The empty determinant is 1. The separate fraction D_K = Δ_K/(1−t) is not the polynomial being factored.
H_ω(V) = (1−ω)V + (1−conjugate(ω))Vᵀ; signature counts positive eigenvalues minus negative eigenvalues. The assigned vanishing theorem excludes ω = 1 and all Alexander roots.
Local sliceness means a locally flat properly embedded disk in the standard four-ball, with the boundary local-flatness and product-collar conditions; it does not mean smooth sliceness.
The right-handed trefoil has positive-push matrix V = ((−1,0),(−1,−1)) in the specified Hopf-core basis.

The reverse mirror applies the fixed orientation-reversing reflection and reverses the knot orientation. The example obtains −Vᵀ through an explicit trefoil-specific basis change from the transported matrix −V.

load_bearing.statement: Let g ≥ 0, L be free abelian of rank 2g, V an integral bilinear form with det(V−Vᵀ) = ±1, and M a rank-g direct summand on which V vanishes identically. With d_V(t) = det(V−tVᵀ) and empty determinant 1, there exists f(t) ∈ Z[t] such that d_V(t) = tᵍf(t)f(t⁻¹).

Assume full AC. For a smooth oriented knot K, a connected compact smooth oriented Seifert surface F and its positive-push matrix V, with Δ_K(t) ≐ det(V−tVᵀ), metabolicity implies Δ_K(t) ≐ f(t)f(t⁻¹) for some f ∈ Z[t]. The same factorization is necessary if K bounds a locally flat properly embedded disk in the standard B⁴; sufficiency is not asserted.

Assume full AC. Let K be a smooth oriented knot with a connected compact smooth oriented genus-g Seifert surface and positive-push matrix V. If V vanishes identically on a rank-g direct summand, then σ_ω(K) = 0 for every ω ∈ S¹ excluding 1 with Δ_K(ω) ≠ 0. No value at an Alexander root is asserted.

Assume full AC. If a smooth oriented knot's determinant-normalized Alexander polynomial admits no factorization Δ_K(t) ≐ f(t)f(t⁻¹) with f ∈ Z[t±¹], then K bounds no locally flat properly embedded disk in the standard B⁴.
